provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Summoner Wars Master Set rulebook v2 (Plaid Hat Games)

steps.text: Unfold the Battlefield between the players, card piles toward them
Two Battlefields side by side (needs a second Master Set, Starter Set or board); split into 2 teams
3 players: the player on their own team picks 2 decks and plays them as 2 separate turns
Dice and Wound markers to the side in reach
Each player picks a faction deck and keeps its Reference Card handy
Place your Starting Setup cards as your Reference Card shows, readable from your side
Shuffle the rest facedown on your Draw Pile space; start with no cards in hand
If your Reference Card lists Vine Walls, keep that many in a Vine Wall pile off the Battlefield (not in the deck)
First player skips phases 1-3 and moves only up to 2 Units in that first turn
Each turn: draw to 5, move up to 3 Units (2 spaces), attack with up to 3 Units
Destroyed enemy cards go facedown on top of YOUR Magic Pile
Summon only next to a Wall you control
Teams: walls anywhere on your team's side; you may pass Magic Pile cards to a teammate in Build Magic
Everyone rolls; the highest chooses who goes first (re-roll ties)
Everyone rolls; the highest goes first, then turns alternate between the teams
